title: Occult Sanctum
notes: Spawn table: bees (from pack), butterflies, occasional bird. Ambient rules: soft chant audio if ritual skill >5, smoke particles from incense offerings, spiritual balance decay slowed.

Lore text: The sanctum is a place of offering, not combat. Shrines accept milk and flowers; altars take incense. Return to homestead is always possible via the courtyard portal. Sourced: domestic ritual spaces in Grihya Sutras and general occult practice of sacred enclosures.
